description: ESPN college football scoreboard for one date: every game with home and away team, score, status (scheduled, live, final) and stadium, from ESPN's public site JSON. Times are UTC; days with no games return an empty list. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_espn_mlb_scoreboard when you need ESPN MLB scoreboard for one date: every game with away; dev_espn_nba_scoreboard when you need ESPN NBA scoreboard for one date: every game with away. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
